name: boost-vpn
description: Install and operate Boost VPN on macOS, Linux, and Windows using downloads from the official website.

interface.shortDescription: Install and use Boost VPN from official downloads.
interface.longDescription: Manage Boost VPN installation, QR login, nodes, connections, diagnostics, and removal on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Downloads the current official installer over HTTPS; release archives and SHA256 checksums are fetched at installation time. No installer or release binaries are bundled.
defaultPrompt: Check my Boost VPN installation status.
Plan a safe Boost VPN installation.
Show the Boost VPN daemon logs.
